title: Margaret Hamilton has died
why_read: A tribute to the death of Margaret Hamilton, the software engineer whose work on Apollo guidance code shaped modern software engineering practice.
analysis: Margaret Hamilton led the team that wrote the onboard flight software for the Apollo program, and she is widely credited with helping establish software engineering as a formal discipline. Her work famously included error-handling logic that saved the Apollo 11 landing when the system was overloaded with spurious data. This news item is a tribute rather than a technical deep dive, but it's a meaningful moment for the field to reflect on foundational contributions to reliable systems design.
